worldcombat.skill.holdhands.summary: Hold hands with an ally: a warm ribbon links you, and while it holds you both regain a little health at intervals; walk apart and the link snaps, taking the happiness from both ends.
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.use.0: Heal two Pokemon while they stand together
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.use.1: Trade a positioning rule for steady healing
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.use.2: Top up both members during a breather
The ribbon lasts %2$s s; while it holds, you and the ally each regain %1$s%% of your own maximum health at intervals.
Cast reach is about %1$s blocks and the ribbon reaches about %2$s blocks; health is shared every %3$s s, and leaving the ribbon snaps it.
preparation %1$s s, cooldown %2$s s from cast.
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.stance.tight: Tight grip: x1.4 healing per beat, but the link lasts only 70%% as long - a short, deep heal up close.
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.stance.loose: Loose grip: x0.85 healing per beat, but the link lasts 1.3x as long - step apart and take it slow.
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.timing: Cast on an ally. After %1$s s of preparation it spends %3$s PP, recovers %2$s s, and commits a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.preference.t: On: x1.4 healing per beat, but the link lasts only 70% as long, made for a short close-range heal. Off: x0.85 healing, but the link lasts 1.3x as long, made for stepping apart and taking it slow. Healing depth and duration trade off.
worldcombat.skill.holdhands.preference.a: Consider holding hands once anyone in the party (including yourself) drops below this health ratio; lower tends to tough it out, higher holds hands at the first scratch.
Hold Hands works on one other living ally; before each beat it checks that both are still within the ribbon. If either falls, is moved out of range, or has the link cleared, it breaks and both stop healing.
